name: MonthlyHousehold

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.background: They want to understand where their money goes each month

scenario_template.topic: Reviewing monthly income and regular expenses
scenario_template.note: They list rent, utilities, groceries, transportation, and subscriptions

scenario_template.topic: Discovering that discretionary spending is higher than expected
scenario_template.note: They realize small purchases add up

scenario_template.topic: Asking how to divide income across spending and savings
scenario_template.note: They want a realistic rather than overly restrictive budget

scenario_template.topic: Building spending categories and monthly limits
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps prioritize essential expenses before flexible spending

scenario_template.topic: Choosing which categories to reduce
scenario_template.note: They compare dining out, entertainment, shopping, and subscriptions

scenario_template.topic: Adjusting the budget after accounting for irregular expenses
scenario_template.note: Assistant suggests setting aside money for expenses that occur less often

scenario_template.topic: Agreeing on a sustainable monthly budget
scenario_template.note: They feel more confident about their finances

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
